senses.gloss: to cause to flow, to make sore.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41">Gen. R. s. 41</cite> (ref. to <he>מוגיך</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 51:23">Is. LI, 23</cite>) <he>אילן דמְמִיגִין מכתך</he> (Ar. <he>דמְמַגְיַין מחתך</he>, fr. <cite ref="M00150"><he>מגי</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="L00362"><he>לַחְלַח</he></cite>; <cite ref="Isaiah 51:23">ib.</cite> s. 69; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 337">Yalk. senses.gloss: (v. Syr. מגיא, P. Sm. 2001) to be languid, to act like a languid person.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 70b">Ab. Zar. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>בעלמא הוא דקאִיתְמוֹגֵג</he> Ms. M. Var. (not <he>איתמוגגי</he>; strike out <he>בעלמא הוא דקמתמוגג</he> as a tautography) he may say, I was only a little lazy (and stretched myself so as to reach over to the neighbor’s roof; Rashi a. l. quotes a Var. <he>מתמוגג אני</he> h.).
